title: Capabilities
subtitle: Manage reusable Skills, MCP connections and API plugins.
actionFailed: The action failed. Please try again.

kindHint.skill: Reusable task instructions and expertise packages
kindHint.mcp: Connect tools and data through MCP servers
kindHint.api: Connect REST or GraphQL business APIs

soon: Managing {{kind}} arrives in a later release.
unhealthyLong: Recent health checks failed: connection issue. The capability keeps its state; check the service and test the connection again.
enablePending: Enable request submitted; available once approved
disableBody: Agents can no longer start new calls; versions and run records are kept.
disableBodyReferenced: Agents can no longer start new calls. It is referenced in {{count}} place(s), which will show as unavailable.
deleteBody: Delete this capability? Existing references will be marked invalid.
deleteBodyReferenced: Delete this capability? Existing references will be marked invalid. It is referenced in {{count}} place(s).
connectedPending: Connected and tested; available once approved

form.name: Name
form.descriptionHint: Routing and agents read this to decide when to call it.
form.transportHint: Only Streamable HTTP for now; stdio is for private deployments.
form.tokenHint: Stored encrypted; only the last four characters are shown afterwards.

oauth.notAuthorized: Not authorized yet — authorize before testing the connection
oauth.done: Authorization complete; the connection was tested again

noTools: No tools yet: they are listed once a test connection succeeds.
statusRule: The capability is available only while the last test passed and at least one tool is ticked; new tools start unticked. Write operations ask the user to confirm in the conversation.

skill.passedAvailable: Security check passed · the Skill can be used now.
skill.passedPending: Security check passed; an enable request was filed and it becomes available once approved.
skill.tooLarge: The package is larger than 20 MB
skill.drop: Drop a .zip or SKILL.md here, or click to choose a file
skill.dropHint: Needs a SKILL.md with name and description; up to 20 MB
skill.replace: Current file: {{name}} (drop or click to replace; a new file is checked again)
skill.builtinNote: Built-in platform Skill (platform-trusted), read-only for tenants: it can be disabled, enabled or copied, but not changed or deleted.
skill.platformDisabled: The platform has switched this Skill off; it cannot be used right now.
skill.gate: Until every check passes the Skill stays unavailable. Scripts are never executed.

platformSkills.title: Built-in skills
platformSkills.subtitle: Skills the platform provides to every tenant; read-only for tenants, who may disable or copy them. Changes reach all tenants at once.
platformSkills.note: Once disabled, no tenant can use this Skill and agents that mount it see it as unavailable. Keep the name and description frontmatter in SKILL.md.
